skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 40% ATK DMG to a single target in a 3-hit combo.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 180% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target for 2 turns (adds 60% ATK worth of Injured DMG when the target is attacked), and inflicts [Weaken] on the target (ATK reduced by 30% for 2 turns).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 220% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target for 2 turns (adds 80% ATK worth of Injured DMG when the target is attacked), and inflicts [Weaken] on the target (ATK reduced by 40% for 2 turns).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. The final hit has a 60% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target and surrounding enemies for 2 turns (adds 60% ATK worth of Injured DMG when they are attacked).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. The final hit has an 80% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target and surrounding enemies for 2 turns (adds 60% ATK worth of Injured DMG when they are attacked).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. The final hit has an 80% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target and surrounding enemies for 2 turns (adds 80% ATK worth of Injured DMG when they are attacked).

effects.desc: Unfavorable effect reduces the target's damage reduction rate by 30% for the duration.
